svg.title: LXP lettering — sharp terminals and radiused bends
svg.desc: Connected LXP mark. X is a single shape with four equal 58-unit, 45-degree arms turning into a joined chevron-style centre. Opposite arms are offset rather than forming straight crossing bands. All four inner corners have 12-unit radii. Outer terminals are square. L bend uses concentric radii of 50 inner and 108 outer, preserving a 58-unit stroke. P unchanged.
